description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Extra Gazette No. 2058/16 of 14.02.2018 - Cad  Map No. 520201 and  Others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title amendments under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing modifications to land parcel details, encumbrances, extents, and registrations in various locations. The content focuses entirely on land administration matters including title corrections, boundary adjustments, and property record updates, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
